item.title: Show HN: Zero-bloat, client-side utility suite with zero telemetry
item.summary: I built an simple unbloated utility suite of 51 actually useful tools that runs client-side on static html. Access is a $2/month subscription for everything on the website, now or in the future, and the tools unlock with a 12 digit key. I built these tools to buy back my time by providing value to workers who need to buy back theirs. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49225010 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
